pages.title: Not A Vehicle!
pages.text: Cushions are stuffed with wool and come in all 16 wool colors. Right-click a seat to sit down.

They only fit where there are two blocks of headroom.$(br2)Chairs can be decorated just like tables: right-click with a carpet or tatami to lay down a seat cloth in any color. Shears take the cloth off again and hand it back to you.
